slice: controlled core planning, multi-step tasks and replanning
purpose: Extend core from a fixed local-note choice to a controlled plan: model submits a plan candidate only, the trusted domain validates structure/scope/dependencies/facts/verifiers and CAS-accepts a plan version, ready steps are deterministically admitted through the existing Task/Mandate/fence path, Task results trigger replanning, and completion still requires independent Task/Effect/artifact evidence plus native Goal complete.

implementation.contracts: CorePlanDraft/Version/Snapshot/StepView/StopConditions/PlanFactRef and status, plan_candidate kind, CoreGoal.planVersion+plans (<=16), CoreEvaluation.plan, receipt planVersion/stepRefs, read-only core.plan command and shared CORE_KNOWN_REJECTIONS.
implementation.domain: strict plan schema and scope validation (steps 1..16, dependencies acyclic and owner-ordered, required facts limited, expected artifact derived from owner content, fixed artifact.sha256.v1 verifier, stop conditions bounded); basePlanVersion CAS with idempotent proposals, old candidates rejected as CORE_PLAN_STALE, plan versions carry evaluationId/proposalId/triggerRefs/reasoningRefs/facts/planHash for traceability; facts are resolved/pending/conflict/unknown/unsourced and named-but-unsourced facts reject the candidate; deterministic ready-step admission in one transaction with maxParallelSteps<=2 using the existing Task/Mandate/fence path; failure/conflict/unknown/tolerated-failure become distinct planning reasons (plan_stopped_*, plan_waiting_fact, plan_tolerated_failure, evaluation_unknown vs evaluation_active); unknown rounds do not re-run across lease expiry/wakeup/reopen; legacy one-step task_intent is only allowed before a plan is admitted (otherwise CORE_PLAN_REQUIRED); core.plan is pure read; unknown commands fail explicitly.
implementation.promptAndPump: deterministic local-core prompt (fixed field order, recursive sort, volatile view identities excluded, plan+fact catalog sha256 digests, plan schema) while keeping the H1 single-step/single-request/stream and zero-tool boundary; core-pump observes and validates planVersion (invalid => degraded, no second evaluation).
implementation.invariants: no runtime.ts/goals.ts/core-decision.ts/worker.ts changes required; core.* dispatch already routes the new read command; completion still only through independent Task/Effect/artifact + native Goal complete evidence; no second Goal lifecycle.
